leads.title: Numerical weather prediction
leads.where: Princeton, New Jersey; Aberdeen, Maryland; Stockholm
leads.why: Computed forecasts became the basis of all modern weather and climate prediction, with direct effects on farming, shipping, aviation and disaster warning.
leads.verify: Date the ENIAC forecasts (1950), the first operational forecasts in Stockholm (1954) and the United States (1955), and record Bjerknes's 1904 programme and Richardson's 1922 hand calculation as precursors.

first operational numerical weather prediction Stockholm 1954 BESK

leads.title: Electric charge, conduction and storage in the eighteenth century
leads.why: Conductors and insulators, the Leiden jar and the idea of conserved positive and negative charge made electricity a science, explained lightning, and prepared the way for the battery.
leads.verify: Give separate dated events for Gray's conduction (1729), du Fay's two electricities (1733), the Leiden jar (Kleist 1745, Musschenbroek 1746) and Franklin's theory and lightning experiments (1747-1752). Philadelphia is in North America; choose the primary place from the evidence.
search: Franklin Experiments and Observations on Electricity 1751 single fluid

leads.title: Wave theory of light established by interference and diffraction
leads.why: Interference and diffraction experiments displaced the particle theory and prepared the ground for light as an electromagnetic wave.
leads.verify: Date Young's interference lectures and papers (1801-1804) and Fresnel's prize memoir (1818-19) and transverse waves (1821). Treat Huygens's 1690 wave construction as a precursor and decide whether it should be the first_known record instead.
